headline: Brazil establishes a national digital-health policy covering data governance and emerging technology
summary: Brazil’s Ministry of Health reported that Portaria GM/MS 12.301 instituted a National Digital Health Information Policy, published in the official gazette on 28 October 2026. The ministry describes a national framework for health-data interoperability, the CPF as a priority user identifier, telehealth, data protection, digital sovereignty and safe, responsible use of emerging technologies. The linked official instrument returned HTTP 502 in this review, so exact operative text—especially any AI-specific duties—was not inspected. The announcement establishes policy direction, not implementation or health outcomes.
